title: Validate isolation and template I/O contracts
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. Fangore needs nested subgraphs to declare typed inputs/outputs and isolation (effects, context refs, budget share) so linkage can reject incomplete nests. Accepts WalkingLabs L14 and Codex guidance[^wl-l14-isolation][^wl-codex-isolation]. Supports personal-agent MH-PA-03 typed I/O[^insp-pa-03-iso]. This is nest I/O — not JobLaneBroker lane isolation (see MH-DOTS-07 / JL stories)[^insp-dots-07-iso].
implementation:
`IsolationContract` and `TemplateIOContract` in `mechaharness.isolation.isolation_contract` capture effect scope, context refs, export schema, budget share, cancel/supersede, and typed I/O for Agentic Recipe / `GraphTemplate` subgraph boundaries.

Acceptance walks the registered CLI verb (TestHarnessCliConfig promotes remaining story probes when no src product verb exists yet).
validation: Harness `user_story` walks the promoted product/test verb (no `probe:` wrapper); hard expects on declared observation keys.
